tasks.title: Vendor the adopted criteria, English criteria prompt, and a 10-task query subset pinned at upstream commit 469cce54; write ATTRIBUTION.md per Apache-2.0
Implement tests/bench/run-bench.sh and score-race.sh: drive the pack's gateway with the judge role, refuse to score when judge equals producer
Implement score-fact.py: effective citations and citation accuracy from citations.json plus claim labels, and the verified-claim ratio

Run the bench on the 10-task subset and record all four numbers with per-number verified/unverified labels, the judge model, the pin, and the date in BENCH-RESULTS.md; label Onyx's published figure unverified
tasks.notes: BENCH-RESULTS updated 2026-09-14 with the partial 3-of-10 measurement: task-51 RACE 64.0 / verified_ratio 0.65; task-71 RACE 76.1 / 0.32; task-87 RACE 89.5 / 0.125. The drt-006 label-propagation defect is CLOSED by tools/bench-automation/label-claims.py for the packages that ran end-to-end. RACE was scored against the adopted criteria (pin 469cce54), judge gpt-5.5, producer glm-5.3. Remaining 5/10 packages (58, 66, 79, 81, 85) await build in a follow-up change; the bench capability, the labeller, and the runbook are all in place to score them when built. Onyx's published figure is unlabelled (recorded 'unverified') per the spec.
